author: ZackyLake
title: GPU unit tests fail to extract OpenVINO package - tbb12.dll locked (Access denied) on Windows self-hosted runner
signature: remove item cannot remove item access to the path is denied unauthorizedaccessexception|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Extract OpenVINO packages step fails: Remove-Item cannot delete tbb12.dll, Access to the path is denied

key_errors:
Remove-Item : Cannot remove item C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll:
Access to the path 'C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll' is denied.
+ FullyQualifiedErrorId : RemoveFileSystemItemUnAuthorizedAccess,Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.RemoveItemCommand
##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.
root_cause: The Expand-Archive step tries to overwrite the previous install directory on a Windows self-hosted runner, but Windows keeps tbb12.dll locked (file handle held open by a lingering previous test/inference process, antivirus scanner, or OS file lock) from a prior job on the same runner, so Remove-Item fails with UnauthorizedAccessException before extraction can proceed. This is a recurring Windows self-hosted-runner environment issue unrelated to the PR's code changes (a CPU-impl event-generation fix in intel_gpu); the same signature has now been observed 16 times across many unrelated PRs, confirming it is a runner-level resource contention problem rather than a code defect.
reproduction_steps: N/A - requires the specific Windows self-hosted GPU runner state where a prior process still holds a lock on install/runtime/3rdparty/tbb/bin/tbb12.dll; not reproducible from a clean local checkout.
recommended_actions: Ensure the previous job's processes (inference/test binaries) are fully terminated before artifact extraction begins, e.g. add a cleanup/kill step or runner-level reset between jobs
Consider extracting to a fresh/unique directory per run instead of reusing and overwriting the previous install directory
Investigate whether antivirus or an indexing/process on the Windows runner is holding a handle to tbb12.dll, and exclude the workspace path
If transient, retry the Extract OpenVINO packages step automatically (candidate rerun pattern already tracked)
prevention_strategies: Add a pre-extraction cleanup step that force-kills any leftover OpenVINO processes and retries Remove-Item with backoff, or extract into a clean/unique path per job to avoid file-lock contention with artifacts from a previous run on the same self-hosted runner.
historical_context: This exact signature (95bb23aa2ed8a84d) has recurred 16 times since 2026-11-09, affecting many unrelated PRs (e.g. #39984, #39956, #39900, #39781, #39568, #39653, #39617, #37406, #39577), all on the Windows GPU self-hosted runner during the Extract OpenVINO packages step. It is a known, unresolved runner-level Infrastructure issue.
